name: generate_illustration
description: Generate an image or a short video clip with fal and show it on the student's screen (also saved locally). Use it whenever the student asks for a picture or a video, and on your own when a realistic visual helps: a neuron firing, ions crossing a membrane, blood flowing through the heart, a cell dividing, a real instrument or place. Describe the scene concretely (subject, what moves, viewpoint); never ask for text, labels or equations in it. Images take a few seconds; video clips about 40 seconds, so say so and keep teaching. Returns once started; a later update says when it is shown or if it failed.

subject.description: Concrete scene, 3–600 characters, e.g. 'close-up 3D render of a neuron membrane: sodium ions rushing inward through open channels as an electrical pulse travels along the axon, soft lighting, no text'.

kind.description: image (a few seconds) or video (a short silent clip, about 40 seconds to make).
